result_text:
I added `analyzeLandscape` as a second name for `updateLandscape`. The `cli` module compiles. I didn't run any tests, and I didn't run `analyzeLandscape` itself.

- **`CommandLineInterface.java`:** `analyzeLandscape` goes to the same `updateLandscape(args)` method as `updateLandscape`, so behaviour and options are identical. With `-help`, it prints usage under the name the user typed.
- **`Commands.java`:**
  - I added `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` and its description, which calls it the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands and the same as `updateLandscape`.
  - `analyzeLandscape` is now listed in the no-argument usage overview, with the same options as `updateLandscape`.
- **`README.md`:** it had no command descriptions, so I added a short "Command line" section listing the commands. It documents `analyzeLandscape` and notes that `updateLandscape` is the same command, kept for existing scripts.

I didn't change `updateLandscape`'s own usage text.
